why: The student gives the right fix for this one hanging program (end main with System.exit(0)) but does not explain why the terminal hangs or name the general class of programs that hang, so by the boundary rule this is L3, not L4.

concepts.quote: You need System.exit(0) at the end of main.
concepts.why: This matches the AudioProgramHangs rule, but it only fixes this one case and gives no reason, so the way's boundary puts it at L3.
